BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: as a hockey fan it has always bothered me that fighting is allowed.  i know that anyone involved in a fight is generally given a five minute penalty. i don't think that's enough.  i believe fighting of any kind should result in a five game suspension.  i think fighting will disappear with that kind of penalty.  there is no need for fighting in hockey. ASSISTANT:

I understand your concern, but fighting does have its place in hockey. It can be an effective way to protect teammates, and it’s part of the tradition and culture of the game. While a five-minute penalty is certainly not ideal, I don’t think five game suspensions are the solution. I think the league should focus on educating players and coaches on acceptable forms of physical play that do not involve fighting. That way, players can learn alternative methods of protecting their teammates without participating in any kind of fighting.
